description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableConnectionMetrics` implementing the `ConnectionMetrics` interface. It provides methods for creating instances, converting from and to JSON, and accessing inbound and outbound metrics related to a connection.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionMetrics
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ConnectionMetrics interface, encapsulating inbound and outbound connection metrics with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableConnectionMetrics instance with specified inbound and outbound AddressMetric objects.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableConnectionMetrics instance from a JSON object, extracting inbound and outbound metrics.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JsonObject, including inbound and outbound metrics.
